evidence.title: GitHub - michaelsieminski/neobrutalism-vue: A vue-based registry of neobrutalism-styled Tailwind components.

name: neobrutalism-vue
summary: 38 neobrutalist Vue components for Tailwind v4, installed from a shadcn-vue registry.
description: A registry of neobrutalism-styled Vue components built on shadcn-vue and Reka UI primitives and styled for Tailwind CSS v4. Components install straight from the registry with the shadcn-vue workflow — no npm package — so you adapt the neobrutalist styling in your own project. 38 registry items, MIT licensed.
contains: neobrutalist styling for Tailwind CSS v4
built on shadcn-vue, Reka UI primitives and VueUse
install straight from the registry, no npm package
